synonyms: The Legendary Wicked Woman Wants a Peaceful Second Life as a Boring Studious Girl
synopsis: "Don’t you think it’s stupid to be so madly in love?" Princess Letitia is due to be executed by guillotine, for the terrible crimes she committed trying to win back her fiancee's love. However, just when she thought she was dead, she was returned back in time for a second chance at life. "I won’t fall in love in my new life. I’m going to live peacefully by becoming a sober, hard-working student with glasses!” But one day, her glasses slip off and Camilo, the school's superstar, sees her true face. Then, for some reason, Camilo begins to dote on her in a tidal wave of affection…!? (Source: Comic Days, translated)

synopsis: After growing up an orphan, Mitsuha has a healthy respect for money and a desire to live well—at least, until she dies after being pushed off a cliff. Waking up in a strange fantasy world, Mitsuha narrowly survives an encounter with a pack of wolves, then realizes she has the power to move between this world and the real one. A lesser person might embark on heroic adventures—Mitsuha instead immediately recognizes the lucrative possibilities of her new situation, and heads out to buy an arsenal of modern weapons. Her goal: to acquire 80,000 gold, and the life of leisure she’s always dreamed of! (Source: Kodansha USA)

The mystery centers around Mayumi Hanazaki, a middle-school girl who used to live with her aunt and uncle until a mysterious person mercilessly killed both. Now, thanks to an unusual incident, Mayumi relies upon the spirit of the legendary detective Kogorou Akechi to solve case. (Source: Anime News Network)

synopsis: Yuzo Karita is 81 years old. He lives on a meager pension. His only emotional support is his beloved dog, Momo. Karita is happy as long as he can be with Momo. One day, during a medical checkup, Karita is told that he has only one year left to live. With his remaining time, he desperately tries to find a foster home for Momo. What fate awaits Karita and Momo? This is a moving tale of an old man, his dog, and the deep bond between them that will touch the heart of anyone who reads it. (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Due to pollution and a shortage of resources, scientists estimate that the planet will become unable to sustain life within the next hundred years. To resolve the issue of scarcity, the world's leaders have come together and decided on a desperate solution-the National Extinction Tournament. synopsis: I met my childhood friend again, and she had become a beautiful and innocent-looking girl. "It's been a while, Hayato." "Haruki, is it?" But only in front of me will she drop her perfect facade and act in the same crude casual way she did before. The distance between us had not changed. (Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

synopsis: Princess Stefanie spent her life one step from the throne, only to be murdered just before her coronation by those she trusted most. Worse, she finds herself surrounded by the children of her very betrayers. She may be trapped in a helpless baby's body, but she still has her sharp mind. Now, Stefanie must carefully plot her revenge while growing up among the offspring of those who had destroyed her. (Source: Tappytoon)

titleRomaji: Hoshi no Samidare
titleNative: 惑星のさみだれ
synopsis: Everything about college student Amamiya Yuuhi is average: grades, looks and his blasé outlook on life. So what happens when he awakens one day to a talking lizard, who informs him that there is a gigantic hammer in outer space, poised to split the Earth into pieces, and requests his allegiance in the fight against the forces of evil? Pretend it never happened! Unfortunately for Yuuhi, a little bit of coercion in the form of a super-powered princess prevents him from returning to his mediocre life-as-usual. In the adventure of his lifetime, Yuuhi will join forces with the unpredictable princess and seek out a motley crew of companions to fight back against an evil mage and his horrifyingly powerful homunculus before the Biscuit Hammer destroys the planet! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synopsis: When a boy consoles Kanamori-san, a beautiful elf whose husband has passed away, by saying "I'll marry you myself," she takes him in as her fiancée...? (Source: Monthly Action, translated) Note: Originally a one-shot published in Monthly KiSSCA 2020 Oct. issue, with a sequel in December. It was picked up for full serialization in Comic Action starting 2023-02-25.

synopsis: Cute but dumb as hell… and somehow still the strongest! ...Reincarnated as an ostrich beastkin with innate physical ability?! With intelligence from my previous life, I lead a flock through a monster-filled hellscape just to stay alive… One day, after saving a party of human adventurers from certain doom, I finally made contact with the civilized world I had dreamed of!!! Unlike the uncommunicative ostrich-kin I'm used to, I'm overjoyed to meet people I can actually talk to… However....! Strong, silly, and completely out of control... Watch out, the ostrich beastkin is on a rampage!
